lines.l: It was cold and winter froze, it's only the beginning
I wasn't in it for the winning
I remember back when it never really mattered how you spin it
Don't get caught in traps and look behind your back
Cause it was many, I was falling back on same old action
Surrounded by the envy, shrouded in deception
Cloudy on that day, stayed in my mind as hard as itching
Called me by surprise, I wouldn't lie, couldn't mention
Outside, venting on the ride amongst attention
We're out of time, some things never die or get sentenced
A century outside, I saw the light by the entrance
